text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I have done it-!!
I've seized first place for myself!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Blasting past my rivals with full throttle
had the audience's hype through the roof, didn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The leg strength I have forged for this very day fills me with pride as a princess...!
choice_data_list: Just as expected of the Princess!
Let's do our best in the next race, too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess must be strong! Noble!
And robust! That is the way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Next time, I'll stun everyone with another
supersized, explosive run――

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I shall overtake them all with sheer force~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess never lowers her guard!
Forgetting tireless effort is simply unacceptable!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I shall temper this leg strength even further through sheer grit!
